{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column
print("First few values of revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nUnique values in revenue (first 10):")
print(sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for the presence of commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any()
print(f"\nDoes revenue contain commas? {has_commas}")"}
